subject: Marketplace listing: hero alternatives + procurement hookup
messages:
From: Sophie Li <sophie.li@retailcorp.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, AWS Marketplace Onboarding <aws-listing@amazon.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@retailcorp.com>
Date: 2028-09-07T15:12:00Z
Subject: Redwood listing: hero options + next steps for onboarding

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the walkthrough today — RetailCorp is excited to get the Redwood Inference offering live in our AWS account. Attached is our current hero mockup (two art variants) and the internal procurement timeline. Before we open the private offer, procurement asked for the following on the public page:

- Short product summary (30–35 words) that highlights cost efficiency and private deployment options.
- One-line call-to-action for trial (we prefer “Start a free trial” vs “Request demo”).
- Clear statement about SOC 2 evidence availability.

Could you share a couple of lightweight hero copy alternatives and a recommended CTA? We’re on a tight timeline: procurement aims to start legal review by Sep 12.

Sophie
RetailCorp — Partnerships

Attachment: retailcorp-hero-mockup-v1.png (image/png, 1.2MB)
Attachment: procurement-terms-summary.pdf (application/pdf, 240KB)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Li <sophie.li@retailcorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-07T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Redwood listing: hero options + next steps for onboarding

Sophie — thanks for the notes and attachments. Looping in Marissa and Jonas to finalize copy & the AWS asset checklist; looping in Sean for procurement alignment.

Quick responses / next steps:
- I attached a short draft with three hero alternatives (A/B/C) and CTA variants. Each is ~30 words. Please flag tone (technical vs business) and preferred CTA.
- We’ll call out SOC 2 as “SOC 2 Type II (available upon request)” unless RetailCorp prefers a different phrasing.
- Jonas: can you confirm the AMI/entitlement language needed so we don’t block onboarding?
- Sean: RetailCorp wants legal review the week of Sep 12 — any blockers for private offer setup if we aim to sign by Sep 20?

I’ll publish the copy suggestions in-line below and attach the doc.

Draft hero alternatives (short):
A) "High-throughput LLM inference that scales with your needs — reduce per-token costs and maintain strict data isolation for regulated workloads."
B) "Ship reliable, low-latency LLM features with predictable costs and private deployment options for regulated data."
C) "Production-grade inference: fast, cost-conscious, and secure — dedicated or private deployments to meet compliance requirements."

CTA variants: [Start a free trial] | [Request a private demo] | [Get started — contact sales]

Attachment: redwood-hero-copy-draft.docx

—Aditya
Aditya Rao | Head of Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Li <sophie.li@retailcorp.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-08T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Redwood listing: hero options + next steps for onboarding

Thanks — nice options. My suggestions below (keeping RetailCorp’s buyer in mind):

General guidance:
- Prefer more benefit-forward language (what they get) vs engineering jargon. Use short sentences.
- Lead with business outcome (cost predictability + compliance) then call out deployment modes.
- CTA should be "Start a free trial" for the public page; use private demo/Contact Sales on the private offer card.

Copy edits (proposed):
A -> A1: "High-throughput LLM inference that scales with your business — cut per-token costs with smart batching and keep sensitive data isolated with private deployments."
B -> B1: "Deliver low-latency, reliable LLM experiences with predictable pricing and private deployment options for regulated workloads."
C -> C1: "Production-grade inference for enterprise teams: fast responses, cost control, and deployment flexibility (hosted, dedicated, private)."

Hero tagline (short, 12–15 words): "Fast, reliable LLM inference with enterprise controls and predictable economics."
CTA recommendation: "Start a free trial" (public) + secondary: "Request a demo"

Localization note: for EU/DE audiences we should swap "trial" with "evaluation" in German assets.

Jonas — any AMI or entitlement phrasing we should bake into the microcopy? I can refine final copy once you confirm.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Sr. Product Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Li <sophie.li@retailcorp.com>
Date: 2028-09-08T11:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Redwood listing: hero options + next steps for onboarding

Marissa — good direction. Technical checklist / copy items to avoid later back-and-forth: 

- AMI/Entitlement: Use the phrase "BYO model and AMI-compatible deployment available; private offer support for AMI-based subscriptions." Avoid claiming "AMI included" unless the AMI is published in the RetailCorp account.
- Billing phrasing: say "Usage-based pricing; billing handled via AWS Marketplace (metered or private offer)" — that keeps it accurate while matching procurement expectations.
- Evidence / Security: phrase as "SOC 2 Type II report available upon request" (keeps it short for the hero).
- Attachment: I uploaded the minimal asset checklist to the shared Drive folder. Make sure the listing includes the SKU mapping and a trial entitlement configured as a privateoffer trial SKU.

If RetailCorp wants the public CTA to trigger a short self-serve trial, we need to ensure the trial SKU is present before listing goes live. That timeline is doable if we get procurement signature by Sep 16.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber | Partner GTM | Redwood Inference
Attachment referenced in body: Drive: /Marketplace/Asset-Checklist (link shared separately)

From: Sophie Li <sophie.li@retailcorp.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-09T09:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Redwood listing: hero options + next steps for onboarding

Team — this is helpful, thanks. Procurement confirms they prefer the A1 wording with the hero tagline you suggested, and "Start a free trial" as the primary CTA. A few action items from our side: 

- Procurement will send a redline schedule and the procurement contact (cc’ing legal) today.
- We’ll accept the phrasing "SOC 2 Type II report available upon request".
- We’ll aim to complete legal review by Sep 15; DocuSign link will follow.

Aditya / Marissa: please share the final copy file and the public metadata (SKU, trial entitlement flag, metering type) so we can forward to our AWS listing team.

Sophie
Sophie Li | Partnerships — RetailCorp
Attachment: procurement-contacts.vcf (contact card)
